statement: hid-nintendo identifies the half by the controller-type byte in the device-info subcommand reply (0x01 left, 0x02 right) rather than by PID alone, reads the controller MAC from the same reply and uses it as the evdev uniq of both the main node and a separate '(IMU)' motion node. Each Joy-Con gets its own main node, IMU node and player-LED set; the home LED is registered only for right-capable types; SL/SR are not exposed when the half sits in the Charging Grip. The kernel never combines two halves.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in the cited source records; host versions not measured
applicability.scope: Kernel source only. Node names come from the HID device name supplied by the transport; exact names over a virtual UHID device were not observed.
